findings.title: Paid cancellation path skips the new workflow-reminder cancellation logic
findings.body: The paid/refund branch returns before the code that cancels workflow reminders runs. For paid bookings that are cancelled or rejected, WorkflowReminder rows are left active, so scheduled workflow emails or SMS can still be sent despite the booking no longer occurring.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancellations are fire-and-forget during booking cancellation
findings.body: deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are async, but they are called inside forEach without awaiting their promises or adding them to the awaited promise list. In serverless or Next.js API-route execution, the response can complete and execution can be terminated before the cancellation writes or provider calls finish, leaving reminders active.

findings.title: Reschedule cancels old workflow reminders without awaiting the async operations
findings.body: When handling a reschedule, the original booking's workflow reminders are cancelled inside a forEach loop, but the returned promises are not awaited. The booking request can finish before the reminder cancellations are persisted or accepted by the email/SMS providers, so old reminders may remain scheduled and be sent.

findings.title: Cancelled-reminder query does not restrict rows to scheduled email reminders with a reference ID
findings.body: The remindersToCancel query filters only by cancelled=true and scheduledDate. It does not require method=EMAIL, scheduled=true, or referenceId not null. The subsequent SendGrid cancellation request uses reminder.referenceId as batch_id, so a non-email row or a row with a null reference ID can cause the API call to fail and interfere with cancellation of valid reminders.

findings.title: A single SendGrid failure aborts cancellation of all remaining cancelled reminders
findings.body: The SendGrid cancellation request is inside a for loop wrapped by a single try/catch. If one request throws, such as from an invalid batch ID, rate limit, or provider error, the loop stops and the remaining cancelled reminders are neither cancelled in SendGrid nor deleted from the database. Those reminders may still be sent.

findings.title: Unscheduled reminders are scheduled without checking booking status or cancellation state
findings.body: The unscheduledReminders query selects email reminders only by method, scheduled=false, and scheduledDate. It does not exclude cancelled reminders or verify that the associated booking is still accepted. If a cancellation write races, fails, or leaves a stale row, the cron job can schedule and send reminders for cancelled or rescheduled bookings.

findings.title: immediateDelete cancels SendGrid but does not persist cancellation state
findings.body: When immediateDelete is true and a referenceId exists, deleteScheduledEmailReminder only sends a cancellation request to SendGrid and returns. It does not delete the WorkflowReminder row or set cancelled=true. If the SendGrid request fails or is rejected, there is no durable cancellation state or retry path, and the reminder can still be sent. This also leaves stale reminder rows for rescheduled bookings.

findings.title: Deferred email cancellation can miss reminders that are due before the next cron run
findings.body: For non-immediate cancellations, the function only sets cancelled=true and relies on the scheduleEmailReminders cron job to cancel the SendGrid email. Because the cron runs periodically, a reminder whose scheduled date occurs before the next cron execution can still be sent even though the booking was cancelled or rescheduled.

findings.title: SMS cancellation failure leaves no retry path
findings.body: deleteScheduledSMSReminder attempts to cancel the Twilio SMS before deleting the WorkflowReminder row. If the Twilio cancellation throws, the error is logged but the row remains without a cancelled state or retry mechanism. The scheduled SMS may still be sent, and no cron job will attempt to cancel it again.

findings.title: Request-reschedule cancels workflow reminders without awaiting async operations
findings.body: In requestReschedule, deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are called inside forEach without awaiting the promises. The mutation can return before cancellation writes or provider calls complete, so reminders for the old booking may remain active and be sent.

findings.title: Workflow update cancels removed-eventType reminders without awaiting them
findings.body: When a workflow is removed from event types, the code calls async deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder inside forEach but does not await the promises. The update mutation can return before the reminders are marked cancelled or deleted, especially in serverless environments, so removed workflow reminders may still be sent.
